_readme: Copy this file, rename it, and fill it in. Keys starting with _ are comments and are ignored by the builder. Every field is explained in schema.md.

meta._id: localStorage prefix for tick-boxes (key = id + '_ticks'). Choose it once; changing it resets every student's ticks.
meta.title: Course · Week by Week · Tier
meta.sub: One sentence on what the page is for and what the student does with it.
footer: Course · week by week · Tier edition
meta._siteUrl: Final public address of this page, e.g. https://example.github.io/re/year11-tier.html. Empty = build copy-links from location.href (fine once the page is at its final address, wrong if it is embedded or moved).

theme._note: CSS custom-property overrides, token name without the leading --. Empty object = template palette.

files._resourceBase: SharePoint address of the uploaded course folder (browser-bar URL of the folder, NOT a 'Copy link' sharing link). Empty = every button opens the copy next to the page.
files._podcastBase: Address of the podcast folder if it lives outside resourceBase. Empty = follow resourceBase.
setupNote: ONE LINE TO PUT THIS PAGE ONLINE
Paste the SharePoint address of the uploaded course folder between the
quotes below. Leave it empty and the page keeps using the copies in
podcastNote: The podcasts sit in their own folder.
Leave this empty if they live inside the course folder.
files._selfCheck: 'audio' probes the first podcast with an <audio> element; 'fetch' uses a HEAD request (use when the podcasts are served next to the page over HTTP).
files._links: One-off URL overrides by resource key, e.g. {"deck_U1_L01": "https://..."}. Keys not listed here are still emitted in LINKS with an empty value.

calendar._weeks: One ISO date per teaching week, each a literal Monday, holidays already removed. NOT a start date plus a counter.
calendar._holidays: 'before': the week number the holiday divider precedes; weeks+1 puts it after the last week.
calendar._exams: Informational. validate() warns if a date does not fall inside a week of type 'ex'.

how.title: Three things, every week
how.lead: Every week on this page asks for the same three things, in the same order.

steps.note: Recognising a word is not knowing it.
